step4_clay_channel.canvas_accepted: 64x128 accepted as asked (no square fallback needed)

pick.why: All four are a straight trough drawn at the three-quarter diagonal (bottom left to top right), 58-64 wide and 82-84 tall, so every candidate is shorter than the 124 target and the job says to pick the best anyway. #1 (58x82) is the one in the job's colours: fired-clay walls in sleeper-ochre lit with sleeper-flesh on the rims (661 and 322 px), the inside dark hollow-deep and watcher-iron with a few pale glints (hollow-dusk, choir-paper). #0 and #2 draw the rims in choir-flame orange (303 and 361 px), the fire colour, and #2 is clipped at both canvas edges with dirt scattered round it; #3's inside is unwritten-tar brown, not dark and damp, and its ribbed sides read as a planter. #1's lip is slightly notched at the corners.
pick.note: not placed, padded or trimmed: ART places it in its cell

notes.retake_check: every candidate is a trough running up the picture (as the diagonal of the three-quarter view); no retake. The job says a short channel is not a retake: ART lengthens it by repeating middle rows.

colour_notes.outline: Every pick outlines in dream-night #1C2147 (across 270 px, along 166, floor 17, channel 0) and/or hollow-deep #2A2540 (across 1, along 168, floor 786, channel 591); the style sheet keeps dream-night for the player and gives props hollow-deep. Not recoloured here; ART's recipes map the outline by role.
colour_notes.skin_ramp: The jars' shade is unwritten-tar #5E5448 (across 262 px, along 371) with a little unwritten-sail #8C7F6E (across 8); the floor's joints and edge stones are unwritten-tar (2552) and unwritten-sail (1155); the channel has 8 px of unwritten-tar.
